title: Ancient Furnace
description:
You can rarely find Ancient Furnaces in cold biomes. Right clicking it with a nether star will activate it (the star is used up), and after heating up for 5 minutes it will turn the area within 56 blocks around it (about 10000 columns) into a warmer biome, removing any surface snow and melting ice in the process. This radius and the heating time are fixed. It will explode once it's done.

Only some cold biomes are changed (for example taiga, snowy tundra, ice spikes and frozen oceans and rivers); biomes not on that list, like warm ones, stay as they are.

properties.label: Obtain
properties.value: World generation in cold biomes (rare); not craftable

properties.label: Config
properties.value: AncientFurnace (worldgen), default true - turns world generation off only
